source_quotes: Context spans out, it is never assigned (doctrines)
and it should know current time as well as assistant etc
Span-out scoping: a span-out inside a project or workspace now skips containers under a different project or workspace
overlap_check: Extends method_2 which has one rule; no duplication of its content.

add_principles.name: Time is context
add_principles.description: A prompt that does not know the current time or the task's timing reasons about the wrong now.

add_heuristics.condition: context is handed to a step as a summary
add_heuristics.action: resolve it from the graph instead

add_decision_rules.name: Span out from seeds
add_decision_rules.condition: context is needed for a step, loop or ripple
add_decision_rules.outcome: fan out from captured seeds along captured relationships, bounded by the reading model's window; never assign context or fix a count

add_decision_rules.name: Respect scope
add_decision_rules.condition: a span-out runs inside a project or workspace
add_decision_rules.outcome: skip containers that live under a different project or workspace and include global knowledge such as methodologies

add_decision_rules.name: Supply current time
add_decision_rules.condition: a prompt is built for a model
add_decision_rules.outcome: include the current time and the task's timing as the host knows them, so the model does not guess
